decisions.rationale: Existing tests encode the superseded Audio Blocks persisted format (separate report/state artifacts, stored audio paths, speaker-name file stems). The approved requirement change deliberately breaks that contract, so these checks must be rewritten against the new contract rather than the implementation being bent to satisfy them. Human authorized continuing through validation without further prompts.

decisions.question: Workflow stage route
decisions.rationale: Check gate complete: contract suite 12/12, all 51 legacy fixtures migrated, full suite 1057 passed / 0 failed, ruff clean, 9 requirements Active, traceability and coverage audits OK, all 9 invariants hold.

evidence.summary: 9 REQ-NO-VERIFICATION findings, all of them the 9 new Planned Audio Blocks requirements awaiting linked tests at the check gate. No REQ-SPEC-MISSING and no other findings, so the pre-existing traceability baseline is otherwise clean.

Created 9 Planned Audio Blocks single-document requirements mirroring the Speech Blocks consolidation set, and updated 9 existing Active snapshots in place preserving their IDs. All 18 point at spec .agentic/specs/audio_blocks_document.spec.md.

12 failed in 0.18s. Red-before-green baseline: every failure is the missing single-document API (write_audio_blocks_document, load_audio_blocks_document, AudioBlocksDocumentError, AUDIO_BLOCKS_DOCUMENT_FILE_NAME, derived artifact paths).

Implementation complete and lint-clean (ruff check . passes on src and tests). New contract suite green 12/12. Legacy fixture migration in progress: failures went 88 -> 71 -> 51. Remaining by module: audio_blocks_service 19, audio_assembly_service 12, audio_blocks_ui_controller 8, characters_ui_controller 4, project_workspace_service 3, speech_blocks_state_service 2, audio_assembly_state_service 2, narator_voice_ui_controller 1. Cause is uniform: fixtures write the superseded list format and speaker-named WAVs.
Lint gate passes across src and tests after the single-document migration.

Session handoff: work paused for a fresh-context session. Branch refactor/audio-blocks-single-document, no commit and no push per operator instruction. Stage is check because tests are being rewritten against the new contract.

Fixture migration surfaced five source defects in the consolidation, all fixed: (1) _attach_current_speech_block_fields did not recompute pause_duration_ms/special_block_status, so a reloaded pause block fell back to the 1000ms default instead of the 500ms parsed from its Speech Blocks text; (2) six _persist_cancelled_state call sites still passed the pre-consolidation argument list (TypeError on any cancel during generation); (3) _attach_derived_audio_path set audio_relative_path unconditionally, breaking the pre-refactor invariant that a set path means generated audio exists, which Audio Assembly inclusion checks rely on; (4) _merge_existing_audio_blocks dropped the persisted audio_can_play flag while the resplit-reconcile path carried it; (5) load_audio_blocks derived the path before Speech Blocks enrichment so content_kind was unavailable.

Operator-visible incident: an inspection command chained a bare 'git stash', which shelved the entire in-flight fixture migration and source fixes. Recovered with 'git stash pop' (no conflicts, all edits verified present). An AEGIS test gate running in the background during that window read the reverted tree; it was stopped and discarded, and both gates were re-run against the restored tree (E-0008 lint pass, E-0009 test pass). No commit, push or PR was made at any point.

Activated the 9 Planned single-document requirements against selectors in tests/test_audio_blocks_single_document_contract.py. Repaired six pre-existing Active snapshots whose linked tests no longer resolved: five renamed or removed by this migration (011f0efd remap test deleted since remapping is gone by design, 6ffb9d11 traversal-path test now missing-derived-audio, 7b2d7d89 legacy-playability test now reconciles-playability, f17bc992 part-path test now keyed-by-speech-block-id, f5c39900 resplit test now keeps-later-audio), plus e4b08ab6 which was already broken at session start by an earlier rename to test_ensure_default_operation_state_skips_audio_blocks. Added spec item S-0001 and repointed CHK-AUDIO-BLOCKS-SINGLEDOC cites_spec at it to clear the pre-existing INV-2 citation failure, on explicit human approval. audit traceability and audit coverage both report OK.

Green: full suite 1057 passed, 62 skipped, 1 deselected, 0 failed. Contract suite 12/12 and every migrated legacy fixture passes against the single-document format. Turns CHK-AUDIO-BLOCKS-SINGLEDOC green; red baseline preserved as E-0003/E-0004.

intent.statement: Consolidate the Audio Blocks operation onto a single authoritative audio_blocks.json document and derive generated audio paths from speech_block_id

spec_items.statement: Audio Blocks persists one authoritative audio_blocks.json document with a fixed root field set and a seven-field block contract, derives generated audio paths from speech_block_id alone, projects the legacy report and operation-state shapes from that document, resumes from document.checkpoint, treats legacy or contract-violating payloads as not-started, and clears the document plus residual legacy files on reset.
